initialJs.rationale: Task12 must move the heavy overview chart out of the initial graph; the negative delta requires at least 56.9% raw and 56.8% gzip reduction from the recorded monolith.

lazyChartJs.rationale: The pre-Task12 build had no lazy chart chunk; this allowance isolates ECharts without adding a chart dependency.

totalJs.rationale: The bounded delta covers Task12 accessibility, retry, and chunk-runtime code while preventing dependency-scale growth.

totalCss.rationale: The bounded delta allows Task12 accessibility state styling while retaining the recorded pre-Task12 stylesheet as the baseline.
